heroHeadline: Iraq Devalues Dinar Amid Parliamentary Opposition as Economic Policy Debate Intensifies
heroSubtitle: Iraq has announced a devaluation of the Iraqi dinar exchange rate, triggering debate within parliament with some MPs opposing the adjustment over concerns about its impact on ordinary citizens and import costs. The move highlights ongoing tensions between government economic policy and parliamentary stakeholders over currency management, as Iraq navigates post-coalition withdrawal economic challenges.
